units.source_text: 此时头中将住在宫中值宿所，便将昨晚撕下来的假袖包好了送还源氏公子，

en.t: At this time, To no Chujo was staying in his night-duty quarters at the palace, and he wrapped up the false sleeve he had torn off the previous night and sent it back to Prince Genji,

units.source_text: 并附言道：“快把这个缝上吧。”

en.t: adding a message that said, "Hurry and sew this back on."

units.source_text: 源氏公子看了想道：“怎么会给他拿去的？”

en.t: When Prince Genji saw it, he thought, "How did he manage to take it?"

units.source_text: 又想：“若是我没有到手这根腰带，倒便宜了他。”

en.t: Then he thought, "If I had not gotten hold of this sash, he would have had the better of me."

units.source_text: 便用同样颜色的纸张将腰带包好，送还头中将，

en.t: So he wrapped the sash neatly in paper of the same color and sent it back to To no Chujo,
